entries.title: Russia frees jailed American Stephen Hubbard during Witkoff talks

entries.title: UK approves Jackdaw gas field after years in limbo
entries.snippet: Drilling is set to begin in the controversial North Sea plot as the government seeks to tackle high energy costs. Environmental groups have criticized the move and called for more clean energy.

entries.title: US sanctions target Iran's rail sector as Tehran shifts cargo from sea routes to overland corridors
entries.snippet: As US sanctions expand to Iran's rail sector, Tehran is relying more heavily on overland links with China and Central Asia. But capacity constraints, delays and costs limit rail's ability to replace maritime trade.

entries.title: Australian MP Helen Haines loses both legs after car attack as suspect appears in court
entries.snippet: Doctors have amputated both of Helen Haines legs after the Australian lawmaker was hit in an apparent deliberate attack. The suspected driver involved in the attack has appeared in court.

entries.title: India news: India-US trade deal 'pretty close,' says Trump
entries.snippet: US President Donald Trump hinted that the US-India trade deal could look different from the previous ones. Follow DW for more.

entries.title: Nigeria records its first Ebola case, in capital Abuja
entries.snippet: Nigeria has reported its first known case of Ebola during Africa's latest outbreak originating in the DRC. Health Minister Muhammad Ali Pate said the patient was a woman who had recently flown to Abuja from Uganda.

entries.title: Lebanon faces uncertainty as UNIFIL mandate nears end
entries.snippet: As UN peacekeeping forces prepare to withdraw from Lebanon, Israel remains present and Hezbollah is still armed. A new EU support mission aims to strengthen Lebanon's army, but will not replace UN peacekeepers.

entries.title: Sudan drone strike kills around 150 in Abyei market
entries.snippet: A drone strike hit a market in the Abyei border region disputed by Sudan and South Sudan and killed dozens. The drone caused a large fire when it hit a fuel depot. South Sudanese officials blamed Sudan's military.

entries.title: North Korean workers treated as 'slaves' at Russian drone factory
entries.snippet: A new report reveals the plight of North Korean workers at a drone factory in Russia. It also raised concerns that Pyongyang could gain hands-on knowledge of advanced weapons systems through the workers it sends there.

entries.title: New EU plan for Arctic warily eyes influence of Russia, US
entries.snippet: The EU unveiled its priorities in the Arctic as it vies with Russia, China and the US for influence. EU foreign affairs chief Kaja Kallas said drone incursions, GPS jamming and cable sabotage undermine Arctic security.
